tagline: Turn pet photos into portraits worth keeping.
description: Pettenderly is an online AI pet portrait studio. Upload one to five photos of the same cat or dog, choose a style and create a downloadable digital keepsake. Beta tools add portraits with your pet and photo cleanup. Paid credits start at $4.99 for 12 images; failed generations do not use credits. Generated details may vary. No physical printing or shipping.
